connector.name: Ironclaw
connector.registryDescription: Sandboxed shell exec for MCP clients: run untrusted agent commands in a gVisor container.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image ironclaw-mcp:v0.1.496. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ironsecco account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IRONCLAW_CONTROLPLANE_URL
env.description: Base URL of your running IronClaw control-plane, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787. This image is a thin client with no host privilege: it delegates every sandbox_exec run to the control-plane, which owns the hardened gVisor launch. Unset means no backend and the tool fails closed.

env.name: IRONCLAW_API_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for the control-plane API (the value the control-plane was started with).
